answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable stake locked for a full epoch before it can earn. A lone island of fake identities cannot afford the ledge: every clone must fund its own stake, so creating ten thousand Sybils costs ten thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs. A public beacon — a signed, time-stamped registry of staked identities — lets peers verify at a glance which agents paid to exist and which appeared for free, so cheap clones are ignored before they can vote or attest.
